text.tspan: Main path for ablation_config=ours: SPAM alignment in all Swin stages; HLG suppression gates on stages 3 and 4.
MMBasicLayer repeats: Swin blocks -> SPAM aligned feature -> residual update;
HLG is enabled only for stages 3/4.
decoder receives post-update skip features Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4
test.py saves 0/255 masks; eval_ris_metrics.py scores them
Solid arrows: forward inference path Dashed arrows: training-only supervision or auxiliary signal
